v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Constántes estóte, * vidébitis auxílium Dómini super vos.
text.en: Stand still * and you shall see the salvation of the Lord.

text.la: Ad te, Dómine, * levávi ánimam meam: veni, et éripe me, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Unto thee, O Lord, * lift I up my soul; come and deliver me, O Lord, in thee do I put my trust.

text.la: Veni, Dómine, * et noli tardáre: reláxa facínora plebi tuæ Israël.
text.en: Come, O Lord, * and make no tarrying; loosen the bonds of thy people Israel.

text.la: Deus a Líbano véniet, * et splendor eius sicut lumen erit.
text.en: God shall come from Lebanon, * and his brightness shall be as the light.

text.la: Ego autem * ad Dóminum aspíciam, et exspectábo Deum Salvatórem meum.
text.en: Therefore I shall look unto the Lord, * I shall wait for God my Saviour.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Ex quo facta est * vox salutatiónis tuæ in áuribus meis, exsultávit in gáudio infans in útero meo, allelúia.
text.en: As soon as the voice of thy salutation * sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. Alleluia.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut hi, qui in tua pietáte confídunt, ab omni cítius adversitáte liberéntur:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy might, and come among us; that we, trusting only in thy mercy, may by thee be speedily delivered from all adversity.
